prompt:
Create a precise transparent anime rigging PART, not a full new hand.
Reference 1: original character art, exact skin colors, original forearm contour thickness, and required placement.
Reference 2: corrected whole-arm anatomy, showing the desired natural short wrist.
Reference 3: failed wrist-part attempt. Its large blurred halo, faded boundaries and short top are WRONG. Do not preserve that blur.

Output only the lower palm plus wrist and a short forearm section, on a 1024x1536 truly transparent canvas, in exactly the original location.
The skin fragment must extend UP to y=595..610, including the lower heel of the palm, and DOWN to y=1000..1020. Its approximate x range is 400..700. The wrist narrows around (570,780) and continues into the forearm toward (460,980).
Keep the original illustration's ivory skin and very subtle pink shading. Use the fine reddish-brown contour thickness of reference 1. The anatomical shape and smooth transition must follow reference 2. The lower palm flows into one short wrist, with at most one short faint curved crease. No rubber neck, skin band, flap, diagonal join seam, double contour or extra joint.

CRITICAL alpha requirement: crisp natural left and right silhouette with only normal 1-pixel antialiasing. All pixels outside the skin fragment are fully transparent. NO glow, haze, shadow, blur, vignette, mist, feathering or soft cloud anywhere around the part. The two artificial open top and bottom cuts should be clean, fully opaque skin ends WITHOUT any ink outline or dark rim. Do NOT fade them out. They are overlap tabs for assembly.
No cup, fingers, nails, upper arm, elbow, captions, symbols, masks or guide marks. Do not center the patch or scale it up. Preserve the full 1024x1536 canvas position so this fragment overlays the original wrist.
note: Native generated PNG preserved. A contour mesh excludes the surrounding glow; UV coordinates retain the original generated pixels.
